limits: Focused regression coverage, not a run of the entire repository test suite.
Software WebGL results verify correctness and repeatability, not physical-device frame rate.
Isolated model, architecture and synthetic-telemetry HUD captures are labeled fixtures, not full-game screenshots.
The live pace comparison interpolates 32 spatial splits from a prior clean run.
Rider motion is authored from reference posture; no motion capture or recovered biomechanical measurements.
The complete graphical riding/replay path remains unverified: both unchanged production journey attempts timed out before riding, and the later physics integration was not browser-journey validated.
